A '''pilot''' [[Pilot/Legends|flew]] a [[Cargo hauler/Legends|cargo hauler]] for a [[Unidentified Human bounty hunter (Valin Horn)|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vrannin Vaxx]], and hunter and inventor [[Dhidal Nyz]] during the hunt for [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]] in [[43 ABY]]. During the chase, Vaxx was [[Laser/Legends|shot]] by the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], piloted by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. Vaxx was flung forward into the command cab, where this pilot was flying the vehicle. Smoke began pouring from the cab, and the hauler went into a shallow dive, forcing the hunters to give up the chase.
